subject: Human Body
title: Probiotics and Prebiotics
description: A fast breakdown of Probiotics and Prebiotics for builders.

hook.text: Probiotic yogurt labels promise gut health. But do the bacteria in them actually survive stomach acid?

buildup.text: Probiotics are live bacteria. Prebiotics are fibers that feed existing gut bacteria. They work differently.

discovery.text: Many probiotic strains die in stomach acid. The ones that survive may not colonize permanently — they pass through.

twist.text: Prebiotics may matter more. Feeding your existing bacteria a diverse, fiber-rich diet strengthens the microbiome.

climax.text: The best gut strategy isn't a supplement. It's eating diverse plants that feed the bacteria already there.

punchline.text: Feed the bacteria you have. Don't just swallow new ones.

quiz.question: What is the difference between probiotics and prebiotics?
options: Probiotics are fibers, prebiotics are bacteria
Probiotics are live bacteria, prebiotics are fibers that feed gut bacteria
They are different names for the same thing
